description: Start a paid Murnau VFX node job in a Murnau session — the same route the editor's start button uses (session ownership, allowed tasks, price, booking). Requires bestaetigt_credits equal to the current price from lab_murnau_vfx_preis; if the price changed, nothing is created and the new price comes back (409). Inputs the editor normally prepares (input_url, params such as mask_url or prompt) must be given; the server refuses incomplete jobs before booking. Poll lab_murnau_vfx_status afterwards.

bestaetigt_credits.description: The price the person agreed to (from lab_murnau_vfx_preis)

media_id.description: Input media in that session's pool

node_id.description: VFX node id in the session graph, if the result belongs to a node

name: lab_murnau_vfx_auftrag
title: Murnau VFX Job
